text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu was watching some kind of 
video on her smartphone. That was—

Watching the footage of her recent races, 
she seems to have something on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I was able to show my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: To the fullest, leaving nothing behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That's why—

Where Mejiro Ramonu showed up was right on 
the track.

She was staring intently at the turf, so 
much so that I hesitated to approach her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I want to savor this feeling just a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "My love for you. My burning passion."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And... I swear it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I will fulfill these feelings, without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I shall devote everything— and shower you 
with love.

For a short while, as if basking in the 
lingering excitement of the race, Mejiro 
Ramonu stood motionless on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I was able to show my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: To the fullest, leaving nothing behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That's why—

Where Mejiro Ramonu showed up was in the 
grandstands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I still want to stay lost in these 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"That heat born from you and I 
intertwining—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A passion that only we can truly feel...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Let us make our next encounter just as 
magnificent.

For a short while, as if basking in the 
lingering excitement of the race, Mejiro 
Ramonu stood motionless on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Surging forth, this fierce passion—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I truly believe my feelings reached 
them."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: However... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep yearning for it. I want to 
keep chasing after the races...

After watching the race footage, Mejiro 
Ramonu seemed to renew her resolve to 
reach even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...It wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Driven by love, I acted without proper 
thought."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I can't let it end like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Never letting the fire go out, and yet—I 
shall devote myself with intellect.

"Mejiro Ramonu narrowly missed out on 
victory. Channeling her frustration into 
motivation, she renewed her resolve."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...This is not good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's all talk with no substance behind 
it..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Never doing that again, no thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Next time, even more, even more—

"Mejiro Ramonu narrowly missed out on 
victory. Channeling her frustration into 
motivation, she renewed her resolve."
